title: remove
summary: Delete a single file or empty directory.
purpose: Delete a single file or empty directory.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Path of the file, empty directory or artifact directory to delete, relative to the source root.

fields.name: recursive
fields.description: Empty directories need no recursive flag. Delete a nonempty directory. Allowed only for paths judged tool artifacts (.test-tmp-*, dot directories, node_modules, …); anything else returns 422.

details: Replace {name} in the route with path_parameters.name.
Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.
Put investigation/debugging temporary files, dumps, and notes in this work token's scratch directory supplied in the ment; never leave them in the project source tree via write or patch.
After write, patch, move, or remove succeeds, summarize the changed source files in the task report.

continuation.ment: Record the changed files in the work report.

details: Report a removed path in the changed-files section.

errors.when: The path does not exist, or is a nonempty directory and recursive was not set.
The path is read-only or locked and cannot be deleted. Retrying will not help (this is not a 503).
The path is root, .git, a directory alias, outside root, or a nonempty source directory requested recursively.
This token does not have the remove scope.
